items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: Alfred, Alfred William, he was playing with a violin player and a bass and a guitar at that time.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear another fellow, Alfred Wilson, a piano player in the district on Basin Street there? It was way back maybe around 1910 to 15 along that period.
Well, Alfred, Alfred William, he was playing with a violin player and a bass and a guitar at that time. Right on the corner, let's see now.
That was a different man I think. This was.
